evidence: Run 37704706106 recorded context_start_world_matched, context_start_world_start_distinct, and context_start_world_teardown_distinct as true; its last_safe also recorded three rows before failure at lifecycle_B_detection.

The source performs Done, result wait, extraction, and three-row wait before the final detection-count read and exactly-one assertion. The prior receipt does not distinguish a failed read from a failed assertion and contains no detection count.

Done unmounts the picker, removes capture listeners, and deletes the owned teardown hook, explaining the post-Done zero listeners and teardown_distinct=false without contradicting the earlier fresh-start observation.
The new distinct lifecycle_B_detection_count stage and bounded counts are prepared for a native rerun on the frozen artifact. This review did not run native acceptance. D158 and D42 remain open.

The producer interception records kind and session_id; the relay window begins at the same before index used by the existing exactly-one check. The new helper counts current-session relay detections, other-session relay detections, and current-session producer detections without changing picker behavior or the assertion.

The diagnostic whitelist admits only fixed target labels and safe integer counts from 0 through 10000. No raw event, session ID, page content, selector, or error string is copied into last_safe by the new path.

The focused unit test exercises mixed prior/current relays, a result event, a nonzero window offset, and one producer event. It is meaningful for count partitioning, while native delivery and exact-count causality remain unverified.

limitations: The counters are sampled when a diagnostic step starts or fails, so a complete sample is conditional on both observer reads succeeding; absent counters should be treated as unmeasured.
